description: This file defines a servlet class 'AddCartProducts' that handles HTTP POST requests to add products to a shopping cart in an online grocery ordering system. It extracts product details from request parameters, manages session-stored cart items, updates quantities if the product already exists, or adds new items otherwise, and redirects to the shop page.

classes.name: AddCartProducts
classes.description: Servlet class handling addition of products to the shopping cart, managing session data and redirecting after operation.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add or update products in the cart based on request parameters.
